name: homey-device-asset-creator
description: Create Homey driver product images and genuine vector icons from device reference photos.

interface.longDescription: Turn your device photos into a complete Homey driver asset set: small.png (75 × 75), large.png (500 × 500), xlarge.png (1000 × 1000), and a black vector icon.svg with a 960 × 960 viewBox. Create clean product images on white backgrounds, preserve the visible device design, derive all three PNGs from one master, and download the four files individually or together in a ZIP. The SVG uses native vector geometry on a transparent background, with detail simplified for small-size readability. Attach a clear photo, add extra views when helpful, and ask for your Homey assets. Use ChatGPT Work with image editing and file creation available. Processing uses the tools in your conversation; the cloud workflow requires no local software installation. Independent community tool by Johan Bendz.
defaultPrompt: Create all Homey driver assets from this device photo. Clean it up first and include the four files and a ZIP.
Use these front and side device photos to create matching Homey PNGs and a black vector SVG icon.
Check my existing Homey asset set, simplify the SVG for small sizes, and correct any issues.

publication.release_notes: Clarify installer instructions and cloud execution, separate maintainer documentation, and add the published privacy policy link.
